fields.summary_ko.0: AMD expects Q3 2026 revenue of $1.32 billion (YoY +42%, consensus estimate), quarterly EPS of $1.94 expected (YoY +61.7%), achieving four consecutive quarters of earnings surprises.
fields.summary_ko.1: Acceleration of EPYC processor and MI350 GPU adoption in datacenter segment expected, with new EPYC Venice processor launch (Zen 6, 2nm technology) enhancing competitiveness.
fields.summary_ko.2: Expanded adoption of Ryzen AI PRO 400 series processors in client segment expected to drive market share gains for customers Dell, HP, Lenovo, and ASUS.
